name: Brumidi Lodge (Sons of Italy)
parkingNotes: Large parking lot ("Huge Parking Lot" in the lodge's own ad).
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking lot.
reviewNotes:
On Route 231. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Brumidilodge. "Largest dance floor on Long Island" is the lodge's own claim and is not recorded as fact.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Deer Park is in the Town of Babylon, Suffolk County. The contact page also lists a kitchen line (631) 586-3928, a catering manager line and a separate catering business (brumidicatering.com, info@brumidicatering.com, Facebook /brumidicatering/); not recorded as the venue's main contact. The page also shows the lodge president's home phone, which we did NOT record. No regular opening hours are published (it is open for events). No Instagram found. Gallery photos are mostly posed groups of members (some with children), so they were not used; the lodge emblem used as the logo is the national OSDIA emblem shown on the lodge's own site.
description: The lodge hall of Constantino Brumidi Lodge #2211, Order Sons and Daughters of Italy in America, on Deer Park Avenue (Route 231). Its ballroom hosts weekly DJ social dances, Western dances, dinner dances and dance lessons, many open to non-members, and it is also rented out as a catering hall.
